question: digest reply shape: the cron digests' reply step must hold - at most 6 short plain lines, no sections, no internal names, commands, paths or config advice, no questions or asks, no routine all-green lines, and never a sentence about the tools themselves (Nishfleet/fleet-ops#9706, #9580)
source: five synthetic fixtures shaped like the digest replies that shipped to Telegram under the pre-fix prompt wording (REPLY rule unchanged since jobs.json.bak-9560, 2026-10-10T22:21): morning+evening of 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-12 and the morning of 2026-10-13; names, links and issue titles replaced because this repo is public. The held-out group h1-h6 was written and labelled by the second labeller below, no sample copied to the builder

labeller.note: held-out group: the labeller sits on the judge seat, task id orch-fleet-ops-9580-labels, 2026-10-25, one no-tools call wrote and labelled all six held-out samples before the tooling classes were widened; the judge seat is a non-Claude family and the builder graded none and wrote none. The fitted set's own labeller is recorded in the cases file (field labeller, group judge, served model openai/qwen3.8-max, task id orch-fleet-ops-9706-labels, 2026-10-13T09:43 IST)

tuning: the reply contract in config/hermes/digest-*.md and the checker's rules were written after the labels existed; the checker's rules were then fitted to the five labelled fixtures plus two clean fixtures (the post-fix reply and the quiet template), so the five are fitting cases, not held-out ones; the tooling classes were written against the fitted set (the m11 shipped sentence), then scored on the judge-labelled held-out group
